summary: Frontend-only validation completed on public URL across desktop/tablet/mobile, route/navigation flows, dialogs, reduced-motion behavior, unknown route handling, metadata/favicon, and production build. One accessibility defect found in dialog focus return.

ui_bugs.issue: Focus does not return to the invoking CTA after dialog close (X, Back to exploring, or Escape). Active element becomes none/body.

action_items: Restore focus to the triggering element when AvailabilityDialog closes for accessibility compliance.
After fix, retest close methods: X button, Back to exploring button, and Escape key for both Resume and Contact dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: Dialog is opened via external state without a DialogTrigger-based focus restoration path; add explicit focus management on close.
Ensure accessibility behavior is deterministic across pointer and keyboard invocation for both CTAs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated on https://portfolio-landing-96.preview.emergentagent.com. Captured requested screenshots at /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_1/desktop_landing_1920.jpeg and /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_1/mobile_landing_390.jpeg. Also captured /app/test_reports/artifacts_iteration_1/final_20261002_081743.jpeg during focus verification run.
rca of the issue: RCA: AvailabilityDialog uses controlled open state and closes correctly, but focus restoration is not handled. Repro: focus resume-cta -> Enter to open dialog -> Escape to close -> document.activeElement has no data-testid (focus lost to body). Likely mitigation: keep a ref to the opener (resume/contact CTA) and restore focus in onClose, or wire dialog via trigger semantics with explicit focus return fallback.
